text: Chioma and Emeka got engaged last weekend in Lisbon. He proposed at the top of the Santa Justa lift. Wedding probably in the spring, nothing booked yet.
Matilda has her Grade 8 piano recital on 14 May. She's really nervous about the Chopin piece. Remind me to text her good luck the night before.
Ben's half marathon is on the 3rd of June. He's been training since March and says his knee is holding up.
Ilse mentioned her parents' ruby anniversary is sometime next month. Her brother Tomás is organising a dinner at their favourite Italian place.
Need to book the MOT before 2 November 2026. Also pick up stamps.
Deepa and her husband are celebrating ten years married on 21/11. She hinted that he'd love tickets to see the Arctic Monkeys.

Dana's play opens at the Lyric on Thursday. She's playing Lady Macbeth and hasn't slept properly in a week. Her brother Archie is coming down from Manchester for the second night, and their mum has booked the front row for the closing performance on 22 November. Dana said she'd love a proper bottle of gin once it's all over. I should send flowers to the stage door before the opening.
Sinead told me the wedding's off. She and Ryan split up in August and she's moving back to Galway after Christmas.
Chloe Kaur won the regional chess championship on Saturday! First girl from her school to do it. Don't forget to congratulate her mum too.
Mai is a huge fan of Studio Ghibli and collects the vinyl soundtracks.
Santiago's band is playing a gig at the Hope and Anchor on 9 October. I'm going with Ines, we're getting there for eight.
Quick one: Olga said her daughter has a swimming gala next Saturday. Olga's dog Biscuit had his operation yesterday and is recovering well.
Eva and Oliver are getting married on 12 June 2027 in Cornwall. Save the dates should be out soon. Eva asked if I'd do a reading, which is lovely.
Katarzyna, or Kasia as everyone calls her, is running the Warsaw marathon in the spring. Must ask her which date so I can donate before.
Archie's football team made the county cup final. Match is on 18 April at the stadium. His dad is driving the whole team up.
Called Jack about the stag do. It's in Edinburgh, the weekend of 7th of March 2027. Ethan is best man and is collecting deposits by the end of the month. I need to send him £150 by Friday.
Jen is struggling a bit since her mum's diagnosis. She says she's fine but clearly isn't. I should check in with her next week.
Lola got her offer from the Royal Ballet School! Starts in September.
Reggie is vegan and doesn't drink. Good to remember for the anniversary dinner.
Teresa's silver wedding anniversary was on 30 September. I completely forgot. Need to send a belated card to her and Frank.
Chen's cello audition for the youth orchestra is on 2nd of December. He's been practising four hours a day and is quite anxious about the sight-reading.

Ahmed and Alana are expecting their first in March 2027. They told family at the weekend. Alana's had awful morning sickness and has been signed off work for two weeks. Ahmed is trying to keep everything going at home, plus his mum is staying with them until the end of the month. Their dog Pepper keeps sleeping on Alana's feet, which she says is the only thing helping.
Ifeoma is singing in the choir's Christmas concert on 16/12 at St Martin's. Her sister Chioma is flying over from Lagos for it.
Agnieszka's brother is getting married in Krakow sometime in the summer. She's not sure she can get the time off work.
Bought the anniversary present for us: two nights in the Lakes, 14-16 February. Haven't told anyone yet.
Ben said his girlfriend Mai finally passed her driving test this morning. Third attempt! Remind me to send her a congrats message.
Matilda Osei mentioned she's been teaching at the conservatoire for six years now. Loves gardening and old jazz records.
Deepa's daughter has a dance competition in Blackpool on the 23rd of November. Deepa is a nervous wreck about the drive.
Ines and Tomás have their first wedding anniversary on 5 July. Thinking about getting them something for the garden, Ines keeps mentioning a nice outdoor lantern.
Dana's opening night went well apparently, though the review in the local paper was mixed. Should ask her how the rest of the run goes.
Uncle Reggie is turning seventy in January and the family are planning a surprise party for the 18th. His wife Teresa is in charge of the guest list.
Need to remember Emeka's allergic to peanuts. Chioma said the engagement party will be in her parents' garden soon, probably after the rains.
Archie is nervous about his grade 5 trumpet exam next Wednesday.

Long chat with Sinead tonight. The move to Galway is happening on 4 January 2027. She's found a flat near the harbour and her cousin is helping with the van. She's still upset about Ryan but sounds better than last month. Her cat Mossy is going with her, which she's anxious about because he hates car journeys. I should call her the week after she moves to see how she's settling in.
Santiago's gig was cancelled, the venue flooded. They're trying to rebook for sometime in the new year.

Eva's hen do will be in Bath, probably in May. Chloe is organising and wants ideas by the end of the month. Eva's sister Sinead wants a spa day, but Chloe is pushing for a cocktail class and a boat on the river. Budget is around £200 each. I need to send Chloe a few suggestions this week and tell her I can't do the Friday night.
Pick up suit from the dry cleaner before Saturday. Wedding at 2pm.
Olga Petrov is a retired violinist. Lives in the flat above the bakery with her husband and two cats.
Jack and Lola are celebrating their engagement with drinks at the Crown on 15/11. I'm bringing the prosecco.
Ethan has a big presentation to the board on 10 December. He's terrified of public speaking. Don't forget to wish him luck that morning.
Ilse said Tomás has been made captain of the rugby club. First match as captain is this Saturday against Bath.
Katarzyna mentioned her partner Jen is doing a 10k for charity on 27 October. Kasia herself is stuck at home with a broken wrist.

Ahmed told me his parents are celebrating their golden anniversary on 8 March 2027. Big party in Birmingham, the whole family is going. Ahmed is giving a speech and wants help writing it. He said his dad would love a framed photo of their wedding day restored. Remind me to look up photo restoration places before Christmas.
Chen and his wife Mai Nakamura renewed their vows last month in Kyoto. Pictures were stunning.
Ifeoma loves crime novels and hates anything with horror in it.
Alana said the baby scan went fine on Tuesday. Due date is 14 March.
Teresa's grandson Oliver is in the school nativity on the 11th of December. He's playing a sheep and is very proud of it.
Agnieszka Kowalski starts her new job at the orchestra in the new year. She's moving to Leeds for it in January.
Matilda's recital went brilliantly! She got a standing ovation. I should ask her about the competition she's entering next.
Dentist Thursday 9:15. Then gym.

Deepa Gupta said her son Jack is doing his first triathlon in the spring. He's 14 and very competitive. She's worried about the open water swim. Jack's dad used to compete, so there's a lot of pressure at home. The race is in Windermere, possibly late April or early May, and they still haven't booked anywhere to stay.
Archie's cup final was postponed to 2 May because of the waterlogged pitch.
Emeka is a season ticket holder at Arsenal. His birthday is 19/02.
Chloe and Ryan are getting married on 6 September 2027. Venue is a barn in Somerset. Chloe asked me to be a bridesmaid! Need to reply to her properly by the weekend.
Ben's race was rough, he cramped up at mile ten but still finished. Should check in with him tomorrow about his calf.
Ines is pregnant! She's due in late spring. Tomás is over the moon.

Lola's mum, Mrs Barros, is having a hip replacement on 29 October. Lola is staying with her for a fortnight afterwards. I must send Lola a message the day after the op to see how it went, and maybe drop round some food the following week.
Santiago's girlfriend Dana is running in the London Marathon in April 2027. She's raising money for the hospice that looked after her dad.

Jen and her partner have their anniversary on the 2nd of February. Jen mentioned they're thinking about a weekend in Paris. Jen also said she'd love a nice leather notebook, which could be a good Christmas idea.
Oliver's mum told me he's been picked for the county under-12s cricket squad. Trials start soon, maybe after half term.
